corrected_summary: BoomTile (Megaboom-derived) in asap7/ORFS reported ~20k global-route congestion overflows at 0.24 placement density; the thread reports GRT completed after changing the global-routing layer adjustment from 0.45 to 0.2 and congestion iterations from 30 to 35, but the changes are confounded and no post-fix overflow count, detailed-route DRC count, or merged fix is reported.
